properties.name: dbmcp.auth.enabled
properties.description: Require a shared Bearer token on all MCP HTTP requests. Default true; automatically bypassed in stdio mode.

properties.name: dbmcp.auth.token
properties.description: Shared Bearer token configured directly in server YAML. Required and non-placeholder when HTTP authentication is enabled; ignored in stdio mode. Never logged or returned. Restart after changing it.

properties.name: dbmcp.switch.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Total deadline for startup validation or a switch, including waiting for another switch. Failed candidates are closed; late validation cannot publish. Valid range 1-300 seconds.

properties.name: dbmcp.switch.validation-timeout-seconds
properties.description: JDBC validity-check and driver login timeout; must be positive and no greater than the total switch deadline.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.url
properties.description: JDBC URL shared by read and write tools: jdbc:mysql:, jdbc:oracle:, jdbc:sqlserver:, jdbc:postgresql:, or jdbc:starrocks:.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.username
properties.description: Database account shared by read and write tools; use a least-privilege account.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.schema
properties.description: Optional metadata schema (Oracle owner, SQL Server/PostgreSQL schema, StarRocks database). Defaults to the connection's current schema. Does not change SQL name resolution; qualify SQL objects explicitly. MySQL uses the database in its URL.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.max-active
properties.description: Maximum HikariCP pool size.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle HikariCP connections to keep in the pool.

properties.name: dbmcp.database.connection-timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait for a free connection before failing.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.max-rows
properties.description: Maximum number of rows db_query returns per call and db_execute returns per result set; does not limit rows modified by DML.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.timeout-seconds
properties.description: SQL statement timeout in seconds, shared by SELECT and DML/DDL.

properties.name: dbmcp.query.max-cell-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters per returned cell; longer values are truncated.

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.idle-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Idle time before an explicit transaction is rolled back and released. Cleanup waits until in-flight execution finishes.

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.max-lifetime-seconds
properties.description: Maximum explicit transaction lifetime; must be at least the idle timeout. Statements are also constrained by this remaining budget.

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.max-active
properties.description: Global retained transaction/opening limit. Each pool also reserves one connection for independent tools when possible.

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.max-statements
properties.description: Maximum statements per db_execute script (1-100). Each statement's result sequence is also bounded by this limit.

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.max-sql-chars
properties.description: Maximum SQL characters per db_execute call (1-1000000).

properties.name: dbmcp.transaction.script-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Execution budget across a db_execute script; each statement also uses the query timeout and remaining transaction lifetime. Driver cancellation is best effort.

properties.name: dbmcp.write.allow-ddl
properties.description: DDL tool switch; when false, db_execute_ddl rejects execution while DML stays available.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-databases
properties.description: Number of databases redis_select_db may switch between; valid indexes are 0 to this value minus one.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-scan-count
properties.description: Upper bound for the COUNT hint of redis_scan_keys.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-items
properties.description: Maximum number of elements per Redis read, write, or delete call.

properties.name: dbmcp.redis.max-value-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters per Redis value; reads truncate and writes reject longer values.
